components.INTERNALNUMBERING: Internal control number for the export (can be ignored)
components.TYPE: Content descriptor: ClaimData, Echart, or patNotes (absent for demographics/clinical)
components.EXT: File extension: XML, HTML, or CSV

fileCategories.name: Patient Demographics and Clinical Data
fileCategories.description: Demographics and clinical records in C-CDA format. Always produces a pair of XML and HTML files. No TYPE value in filename.

fileCategories.name: Patient Billing and Claims Data
fileCategories.description: Billing and claims data including CPT, ICD, NDC codes, charges, payments from multiple payors, adjustments, and balances.

fileCategories.name: Adhoc Patient Notes
fileCategories.description: Telephone calls and adhoc notes documented via Patient Notes feature. Includes user, subject, category, date, and note text.

fileCategories.name: Scanned Records
fileCategories.description: All patient scanned and uploaded documents, coded using Base64 encoding within CDA XML. May be large depending on volume of scanned data.
